messages:
maria: Heads-up — PR 9123 needs 2x LGTM before today's hotfix cutoff (t-40m). It's the rollback-safety shim for the quant stash. Deploy risk if we miss the window. Link: https://git.redwood/pr/9123 :eyes:

aj: I can grab this now. Quick question — what's the minimal checklist to sign off?

maria: checklist: 1) unit tests green, 2) smoke on staging, 3) rollback exercised, 4) metrics alert for kv-oom. Ran unit tests locally, all green. smoke command: `./scripts/smoke.sh staging --pr 9123`

lee: I'll run the rollback exercise and smoke on staging, ETA ~15m :thumbsup:

sam: FYI this touches kv-cache warming path — please run with kv-cache=false on the canary. Left an inline comment on the PR re: an edge-case for empty prompts.

aj: saw the comment, I left suggestion to tighten the timeout from 30s -> 10s. Can we run smoke with a timeout override?

maria: use this short command for the timeout override: ```KVCACHE_TIMEOUT=10 ./scripts/smoke.sh staging --pr 9123```

deploy-bot: Reminder: hotfix cutoff at 4201235000 (in ~20m). Rolling window policy: merges require 2 approvals after this notice.

natalie: I'm +1 on the change in principle, would like infra-owner (lee or aj) to sign off after smoke passes. Will approve post-smoke.

lee: smoke passed on staging. Rollback exercised and verified. Log excerpt: ```rollback ok: reverted kv-writes for 30s window; metrics stable```

sam: LGTM from me (manual review) — tagging as first approver :white_check_mark:

aj: LGTM after timeout tweak, approving now. :rocket:

maria: Thanks everyone — merging after CI finishes. I'll post a cutover update once the rollout's green. :pray:

deploy-bot: CI pipeline started for merge; build 7890. Status updates will appear in #eng-releases.
